blocks.text: A base-2 number system using the digits 0 and 1. Each position has a value that is a power of two.
blocks.hint: 二进制只有 0 和 1；每一位的位权都是 2 的整数次幂。

blocks.title: Why computers use binary
items: Digital circuits can reliably distinguish between two states, such as high and low voltage.
These states can be represented by the binary digits 1 and 0.

blocks.title: Why hexadecimal?
blocks.text: One hexadecimal digit represents four binary bits. Hexadecimal makes a long binary value shorter to write and easier for a person to read and check.
blocks.hint: 一个十六进制数字对应四个二进制位。

blocks.title: An 8-bit place-value table
blocks.hint: 上排为位权，下排为二进制数字。只把数字为 1 的各列位权相加。

blocks.title: Binary to denary
steps: Select the place values whose digits are 1: 32, 8, 4 and 1.

blocks.title: Binary to hexadecimal
items: Split the 8-bit value into two groups of four: 0010 | 1101.
Convert each group: 0010 is 2; 1101 is D.
Keep the group order to obtain 2D.

blocks.text: Overflow occurs when the result of a calculation is outside the range that can be represented with the available bits. An unsigned 8-bit integer has a range of 0 to 255.
blocks.hint: 这里讨论的是无符号 8 位整数，最大值为 255。

blocks.title: Adding 200 and 100
steps: The binary sum is 1 0010 1100, which requires nine bits.
If only the lowest eight bits are retained, the stored value is 0010 1100, or 44 in denary.
blocks.result: 300 cannot be represented as an unsigned 8-bit integer: an overflow occurs.

blocks.title: Exam explanation
blocks.text: The sum exceeds 255, the largest unsigned value that eight bits can represent. A ninth bit is required to store the correct result.
blocks.hint: 解释时指出：正确结果、可表示范围，以及为什么现有位数不足。
